Located on<ref name="RC:HC" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], '''Fleet Support Base''' was established as a part of [[Fleet Support]] and was in use by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] for at least three [[Standard month/Legends|months]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Fleet Support Base contained a [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] storage room that had been re-purposed to be a briefing area, as well as [[Barracks/Legends|accommodations]] for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="RC:HC" />

After the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Fleet Support&mdash;and by extension Fleet Support Base&mdash;was called upon to receive twenty thousand [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in various states of injury, in addition to another seventy-two thousand combat-ready troops. The base was considered by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] to be ill-equipped to support the tens of thousands of clone [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] it housed in the aftermath of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fleet Support Base appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|Hard Contact]]'', the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
